added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite field is empty, so the base arm is not readable through the field the promotion suite-delta reads and the added-failure count derives unmeasured (null) rather than a measured zero; a base arm was in fact run (baseline-test.log, revision 8069f5ee700e689f52f201c2aec905ca4926c04c, 2 failed reproducing the missing-field defect) but is recorded only under test_logs.

follow-on: source_description_only is true for any batch whose signals are all discovery_source=="edas", so the catalogue-only update applies to every EDAS ingest, not only the one-off backfill section 65 describes; a routine EDAS re-scan (for example section 55) will therefore no longer reset claimed_at or refresh description/status on existing rows, and a batch that mixes EDAS and non-EDAS signals silently falls back to s += scanned, a branch no test exercises.

follow-on: test_edas_seed_uses_catalogue_only_update_for_existing_rows asserts only that ingest_discovered_signals received source_description and discovery_source on the scanned dict; it does not exercise the ON MATCH Cypher that the edas predicate selects, so the batch-selection logic is covered by a single live-graph test and a regression that mis-selected the branch would pass the unit-level seed test.

follow-on: the field is declared in the source schema, but the FacilitySignal model the tests construct is generated into a gitignored file, and the reviewed run's tests depend on an injected generated model; a checkout whose generated model predates this change would error at import rather than exercise the change, so integration depends on regenerating the model in the main checkout (recorded by the reviewed run as a follow-on).
